CENTRAL SECTION 
Orders  and  Notifications  (Other than those published in Part IV-B) 
under the Gujarat Local Boards, Village Panchayats, Municipal 
Boroughs, District Municipal, Primary Education and Local Fund Audit Acts. 
 
 
 
PANCHAYATS, RURAL HOUSING AND RURAL DEVELOPMENT DEPARTMENT 
NOTIFICATION 
Sachivalaya, Gandhinagar, 1st February, 2022 
GUJARAT PANCHAYATS ACT, 1993. 
No.KP/04/2022/PRR/102013/1846/KH :- In exercise of the powers conferred by sub-section 5 of 227 read with section 
274 of the Gujarat Panchayats Act, 1993 (Guj.18 of 1993), the Government of Gujarat hereby makes the following rules 
further to amend the Compounder, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service Recruitment Rules, 2013, namely:- 
1. 
These rules may be called the, Compounder, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service Recruitment 
(Amendment) Rules, 2022. 
2. 
In the Compounder, Class III, in the Superior Panchayat Service Recruitment Rules, 2013 (hereinafter referred to 
as “the said rules”) in the preamble, for the word “Compounder”, the words “Junior Pharmacist” shall be 
substituted. 
3. 
In the said rules, in rule 1, rule 2 and rule 5 for the word “Compounder”, the words “Junior Pharmacist” shall be 
substituted. 
4. 
In the said rules, in rule 3, in clause (b), in sub-clause (i), after the words “a bechelor’s degree in Pharmacy”, the 
words and brackets “or degree of Doctor of Pharmacy (Pharm D.)” shall be inserted. 
 
By order and in the name of the Governor of Gujarat, 
HITESH GOHIL, 
Deputy Secretary to Government. 
----------
